{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for SEVERE severity
print("Patients with SEVERE disease:", df['severity'].isin(['severe']).sum())

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Number of duplicate patient_id values:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check for retested patients (sample_seq > 1)
print("Number of retested patients (sample_seq > 1):", (df['sample_seq'] > 1).sum())"}
